## Build 61 – Pairing scheduler independence

Build 61 contains a targeted change for pairing failures seen on some SideStore-resigned installations.

### What was happening

SideStore can change Roam Control's bundle identifier when resigning the app.

On affected installations, the runtime bundle identifier could therefore differ from the background-task identifiers contained in the IPA. iOS could reject Roam Control's pairing BGTaskScheduler configuration as a result.

In previous builds, that mismatch could prevent the pairing listener from starting at all.

### What changed in Build 61

- Pairing no longer depends on successful BGTaskScheduler registration or submission.
- The RPPairing listener now starts directly when a pairing attempt begins.
- Pairing can continue even when the SideStore runtime bundle identifier does not match the permitted background-task identifier.
- The scheduler configuration is still retained in diagnostics.
- A UIKit background-task assertion is used to cover the brief Settings → Developer Mode → Pair with Host transition.
- Pairing cleanup still occurs on success, failure, cancellation or timeout.
- Build 60 location-session behaviour is unchanged.

### Testing completed

Build 61 has been tested successfully on-device with:

- Removing an existing pairing
- Starting a fresh pairing attempt
- Leaving Roam Control and opening Settings
- Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Mode → Pair with Host
- Completing the 6-digit pairing flow
- Saving the new pairing record
- Starting a location session after pairing
- Stop & Restore

Automated tests covering runtime background-task identifiers, pairing/location pre-registration, failure stages, telemetry/privacy behaviour and Build 61 release invariants also pass.

A clean unsigned Release build for arm64 also completed successfully.

### Preview testing

Build 61 was initially released as a Preview while the pairing change was tested across a wider range of SideStore installations.

Following successful real-world testing, Build 61 has now been promoted to the main Roam Control 0.9.2 release.

If you experience a connection or pairing problem, go to:

Settings → Connection Health → Copy Diagnostics

and include the copied diagnostics with your report.

### Download

Install the attached `RoamControl-0.9.2-build61.ipa` through SideStore as normal.
